muzik/kat7_gerilim.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Dark cinematic horror underscore for a night security guard alone in an old building. Slow, sparse and unsettling: deep sub-bass drone, a faint heartbeat-like low pulse, dissonant high sustained strings that slowly swell, occasional distant metallic scrapes and reversed piano notes. No melody, no drums, no vocals. Builds tension very gradually, never resolves.

No drums, no vocals, no melody resolution. Creepy, lonely, tense, slowly building dread.
